parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to query the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content. A conditional expression is used to match user requests. Settings for this parameter are not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specific requests: Set the value to a custom expression, such as (http.host eq "video.example.com")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable forced HTTPS. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启强制HTTPS，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_force

parameters.help_en:
The HTTP status code for forced HTTPS redirection. Valid values:
301
302
307
308
parameters.help_zh:
强制HTTPS跳转状态码，取值范围：
301
302
307
308
parameters.name: https_force_code

parameters.help_en:
The feature switch. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
功能开关，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Alt-Svc header includes the clear parameter. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Alt-Svc头是否包含clear参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc_clear

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the Alt-Svc header includes the persist parameter. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
Alt-Svc头包是否含persist参数，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: alt_svc_persist

parameters.help_en: The validity period of the Alt-Svc header, in seconds. Default value: 86400
parameters.help_zh: Alt-Svc有效时间，单位是秒，默认为86400秒
parameters.name: alt_svc_ma

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS). Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts

parameters.help_en: The expiration time of HSTS, in seconds
parameters.name: hsts_max_age

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to include subdomains in HSTS. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否在HSTS中包括子域，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts_include_subdomains

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable HSTS preload. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启HSTS预加载，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: hsts_preload

parameters.help_en: The execution sequence of the rule. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Server Name Indication (SNI) verification. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启SNI校验，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_sni_verify

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to reject TLS handshake requests without SNI. Default value: off. Valid values:
on: Enabled.
off: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启拒绝无SNI的TLS握手请求，默认关闭。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: https_no_sni_deny

parameters.help_en: The SNI whitelist. Separate multiple SNI values with spaces
parameters.help_zh: 指定允许的SNI白名单列表，多个以空格分隔
parameters.name: https_sni_whitelist
